name: nexis-backend
description: NEXIS Backend - AWS Lambda functions for eligibility checking and AI services

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../lambda.zip .
scripts.deploy:dev: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file cloudformation/main-stack.yaml --stack-name nexis-dev --parameter-overrides Environment=dev
scripts.deploy:staging: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file cloudformation/main-stack.yaml --stack-name nexis-staging --parameter-overrides Environment=staging
scripts.deploy:prod: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file cloudformation/main-stack.yaml --stack-name nexis-prod --parameter-overrides Environment=prod
